name: mutext
description: Jekyll prototype for the μ-text narrative troubleshooting simulator.

scripts.build: npm run tailwind:build && GEM_HOME=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 GEM_PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.check: npm run check:puzzles && npm run check:continuity && npm run test:puzzles
scripts.check:puzzles: cd checker && uv run check_puzzle.py puzzles --strict --posts ../_posts
scripts.jekyll:build: GEM_HOME=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 GEM_PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.jekyll:serve: GEM_HOME=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 GEM_PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0 PATH=vendor/bundle/ruby/3.4.0/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --baseurl ''
